clips.title: The story
paras: The Warsong Labor Camp is an isolated Horde timber-harvesting outpost tucked away in southeastern Ashenvale. Operated by Warsong loggers and defended by orcish sentries, the work site cuts lumber to fuel the growth of Durotar while braving the hostility of the surrounding forest.

Situated east of Fallen Sky Lake and southwest of the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, the Warsong Labor Camp exists for one vital purpose: harvesting the dense timber of Ashenvale. The dry plains of Durotar offer little usable lumber to build cities like Orgrimmar, forcing the Warsong clan to push deep into the contested woods. Staffed by hardy loggers and orcish guards, the site operates in relative isolation, grinding through ancient trees despite the ever-present threat of night elf scouts and passing Alliance warbands.

Because of its remote location far from the main road and fortified bases like Splintertree Post, the camp is exceptionally vulnerable. Alliance raiders often strike the working peons and watchmen, knowing reinforcements will not arrive swiftly. To the night elves, every felled tree is an act of sacrilege, turning this mundane logging camp into a perennial flashpoint in the regional war.
